text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The much anticipated Japanese<n>Derby is here, and
the entire audience<n>is focused on the long-awaited
showdown between the BNW trio.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Prior to the race, Biwa Hayahide<n>senses something
peculiar about<n>Winning Ticket, just like with Narita
Taishin at the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket's dream is to win the<n>Derby. Her
focus has been so<n>singular that she's been
isolating<n>herself to train for it.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide tries to convince<n>herself that she
can pin down the<n>source of that strange feeling as
she<n>heads out to the race.
